title: How Fonderie works
lede: Fonderie is off-the-shelf SaaS infrastructure that lives in your repo. Auth, billing, teams, permissions — all tested, all documented. Your AI reads the playbook and assembles the modules. No improvisation. No reinventing auth every session.

steps.title: You describe your product
steps.text: "I need a SaaS with login, Stripe billing, and team workspaces."

steps.title: Your AI follows the assembly guide
steps.text: Fonderie's playbook tells your AI exactly which modules to use and how to wire them. Switch AI assistants anytime — the instructions stay the same.

steps.title: Proven modules, not improvised code
steps.text: Auth, billing, and teams are pre-built and tested. Your AI assembles them. It doesn't guess. It doesn't skip webhooks. It doesn't hardcode secrets.

steps.title: You review and ship
steps.text: You own the code. Customize the UI, add your logic, deploy. Your backend is secure, your frontend works, and your customers can sign up and pay.
